recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle urban photograph of four men in 1970s fashion standing on a brownstone stoop, contrasted with an older man sitting in the foreground, all framed by a series of thin white concentric circles radiating from the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circles acting as a graphic overlay that flattens the 3D space
Juxtaposition between the standing group in the background and the seated individual in the foreground
Integration of curved typography following the path of the circular graphic elements
coreInvariants: Ornate wrought iron railings on the periphery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures stand at the top of the stairs (mid-ground); one figure sits on the lower steps (foreground).
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point of the concentric circles, located between the two central standing figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the rings outward from the center to the standing figures, then drops to the foreground figure and the curved text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the gaps between the concentric rings provide visual breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and grays of the stone architecture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues, greens, and browns of the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange-red and royal blue for the curved text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a vintage film grain; high value contrast in the white graphic rings.

letterConstructionRules: High-contrast strokes with thin hairlines and thick stems
Curved baselines that follow the arc of the concentric circles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used in two different colors to distinguish between title and artist.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, organic curves of the lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of four men in 1970s leather and denim standing on the top of a brownstone stoop, with an older man in a hat sitting on the lower steps. Overlay 8-10 thin, perfectly centered white concentric circles across the entire frame. Muted vintage film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom decorative serif text following the path of the circles. The top text should be in royal blue, arched upwards. The bottom text should be in orange-red, arched downwards, featuring long swashes on the descenders.

verificationChecks: Does the text follow the curvature of the rings?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?

mustRedesign: Any brand logos or record label marks
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Precise geometric alignment of the rings
Fluid integration of text and graphic circles

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rings do not obscure the subjects' faces excessively.
Check that the text colors have enough contrast against the background.
Verify the low-angle perspective creates a sense of height.
Confirm the grain texture is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a multi-subject urban portrait + apply geometric concentric ring overlay + add path-aligned psychedelic serif typography.
